title: Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A classic Spanish dish made with chicken, rice, and a blend of earthy and velvety flavors.

ingredients.name: Vegetable broth
ingredients.notes: chicken or beef broth works well

instructions: In a large paella pan or skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the Spanish sausage and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic, red bell pepper, and smoked paprika (if using) and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth, tomato paste (if using), and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the rice is cooked.
Stir in the green olives and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley (if using).
